mapper.select: SELECT a.chatCode FROM chatparticipant_tbl a JOIN chat_tbl b ON a.chatCode = b.chatCode WHERE userId=#{userId} and type=#{type};
SELECT type FROM chat_tbl where chatCode = #{chatCode};

SELECT * FROM chatmessage_tbl where chatCode=#{chatCode} and createAt>=(SELECT createAt from chatparticipant_tbl where chatCode=#{chatCode} and userId =#{userId}) order by createAt;
SELECT * FROM chatmessage_tbl where chatCode=#{chatCode} and userId=#{userId} and nickName=#{nickName} and content=#{content} ORDER BY createAt DESC LIMIT 1;;

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatmessage_tbl(chatCode, userId, nickName, content, createAt, isRead, isFile) VALUES(#{chatCode}, #{userId}, #{nickName}, #{content}, #{createAt}, #{isRead}, #{isFile});
